category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, increase tied embedding and GRU width to 192 while reducing Adam learning rate to 8e-4. Greater capacity may capture diverse interests, with smaller updates stabilizing optimization. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor loading propagate the new width consistently. Keep dropout and all other settings unchanged, retaining one independent GRU4Rec model per dataset.

response.change_summary: Jointly tune shared GRU4Rec width from 128 to 192 and Adam learning rate from 1e-3 to 8e-4. Existing metadata keeps checkpoint and predictor shapes consistent.
